acceptanceCriteria: The corvint affected plan path re-reads HEAD after its final source observation and refuses unsupported-affected-drift on any change, matching the discovery producer ordering fixed for #709.
An injected HEAD move between the last HEAD read and source verification fails the command in a failing-before test.
body: Found in the #709 review round (claude/gh709-playwright-affected c757c251): the discovery producer now verifies sources then re-reads HEAD, but the pre-existing affected plan path near cmd/corvint/affected.go:450 still reads HEAD before its source verification, leaving a drift window where HEAD can move to a same-tree commit and the plan binds the old revision.
